COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
10.10.2023 CRLR No. 733 of 2023
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Proposed Criminal Revision has been 
filed challenging the order dated 
05.09.2023, passed by learned Judge, 
Family Court, District Nainital in 
Miscellaneous Criminal Case No. 110 of 
2023, by which, learned Judge has directed 
the revisionist to pay Rs. 5,000/- per month 
to his wife, respondent no. 2/applicant for 
her interim maintenance. 
2. Heard Mr. Nitin Tewari, learned 
counsel for the revisionist and Mrs. Manisha 
Rana Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State. 
3. Mr. Nitin Tewari, Advocate, submits 
that the revisionist was married to the 
respondent no. 2 -applicant on 08.12.2022.
After the marriage took place, he came to 
know that the respondent no. 2 was already 
married and she had married the revisionist 
without getting a divorce from her first 
husband Girish Chaudhary. 
4. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 
before Admission.
5. Steps to be taken within 48 hrs. 
6. List on 02.11.2023.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 10.10.2023
Shiksha

Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Digvijay Singh Bisht, learned 
counsel for the revisionist.
2. Mr. Jai Prakash Kandpal, learned 
Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Ajay Singh Bisht, learned counsel 
for respondent no.2.
4. Learned counsel appearing for 
respondent no.2 submits that, owing to 
certain personal reasons, he seeks 
permission to withdraw his Vakalatnama 
from the present criminal revision.
5. Respondent no.2 is present in person 
before the Court. She submits that the 
revisionist has not paid the maintenance 
amount awarded in her favour and, on 
account of her financial constraints, she is 
not in a position to engage a private 
counsel to contest the present revision. 
She, therefore, prays that a legal aid 
counsel be appointed to contest her case.
6. Having regard to the submissions 
made by respondent no.2 and considering  her inability to engage counsel, this Court 
deems it appropriate to provide legal 
representation to her through the Legal 
Services Authorities. Accordingly, Ms. Indu 
Sharma, learned counsel, is appointed as 
Legal Aid Counsel to represent respondent 
no.2 and to assist the Court in the present 
matter.
7. Mr. Ajay Singh Bisht, learned counsel, 
who has sought withdrawal from the case, 
shall hand over the complete paper book of 
the revision along with all relevant 
pleadings and documents available with 
him, to Ms. Indu Sharma, learned Legal 
Aid Counsel.
8. List this case on 07.08.2026.
9. Learned counsel for the revisionist 
shall obtain instructions, in the meantime, 
regarding the amount of maintenance, if 
any, paid by the revisionist to respondent 
no. 2 and the amount of maintenance, if 
any, that remains outstanding and payable 
by him.
10. Registry is directed to delete the name 
of Mr. Ajay Singh Bisht, learned counsel on 
behalf of respondent no.2 in the next cause 
list by replacing the name of Ms. Indu 
Sharma, learned legal aid counsel.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
 31-07-2026
Mamta

 Versus

Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Digvijay Singh Bisht, learned counsel for 
the revisionist. 
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, learned A.G.A. for the State 
of Uttarakhand. 
Ms. Indu Sharma, learned Legal Aid Counsel 
for respondent no. 2.
2. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that 
the arrears of maintenance are to the tune of ₹1.42 
lakh.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent submits that 
the revisionist is not even paying the monthly 
maintenance regularly as directed by the Family Court 
and, therefore, the revisionist may be directed to pay 
the outstanding dues.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. It is directed that the revisionist shall pay a sum 
of ₹50,000/- to the respondent within four weeks from 
today. In the event the aforesaid amount is paid within 
the stipulated period, the recovery proceedings 
initiated by the respondent in respect of the arrears of 
maintenance shall remain stayed till the next date of 
listing.
6. It is made clear that in case the revisionist fails 
to comply with the aforesaid direction within the 
stipulated period, this order shall stand automatically 
vacated without any further reference to the Court.
7. List this case on 24.09.2026.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
 14-08-2026
